notes.title: Kosta Projekt English version is available.
notes.content:
The full version of the game in English is now available.
This version offers an English interface, subtitles and some audio.

Added:
- X and Y axis options
-Game speed
-Some bugs fixed

If you have already purchased the Polish version of the game, just uninstall it
and reinstall with the selected English version.

Have fun.
